prose: A New York Times report that Massachusetts' gambling regulator will examine how DraftKings and other betting companies use AI. The body was not captured (fetch error), so this summary rests on the headline.

On that basis: regulators are starting to look at algorithmic personalization in sports betting - targeted promos, odds presentation, and profiling of bettors - as a consumer-protection question. The examination's scope and what prompted it are unknown from the capture.
highlights: Massachusetts' gambling regulator will examine betting companies' AI use, per NYT
At stake: AI-driven personalization of promos, odds and bettor profiling
Body not captured; scope and triggers unknown
